title: Enter the medical history
summary: Personal history, medication, family history, allergies and habits. Allergies and ailments show as an alert on the record.

steps.title: Menu → Patients
steps.details: Patient list; tapping one opens their record on the right.

steps.title: Open their record
steps.details: Tap the patient in the list. The guide continues once their record is open.

steps.title: Personal history
steps.details: The patient's diseases and conditions. Add one with +.

steps.title: Medication
steps.details: What they regularly take: it's checked when prescribing.

steps.title: Allergies
steps.details: They show as a red alert in the record's header.

steps.title: Add allergy
steps.details: Choose the allergy from the catalog and its severity.
